name: mirage
text: Checked the engine just now. Sockets live: Kalshi, SX Bet, PropLine (board + signals, frames 0-3 s old) and ParlayAPI (about 210 connections, last frame 0 s ago). Not live: BoltOdds (lines and props sockets), and SharpAPI's socket is off. PropLine's stream also reports 11 connections against a cap of 2 on your tier, and ParlayAPI's hot streams sometimes drop with 503/timeouts. Matching: PropLine and ParlayAPI are both feeding the same books and being compared line by line (about 1.1 pt gaps on the same book, so the matching holds). PropLine is the main Pinnacle-price source. I haven't changed anything yet. I wrote it into TASKS as SK1 to find why BoltOdds isn't connecting, check the PropLine connection cap, and see whether the SharpAPI socket add-on still exists.
